title: Embedded integral scalar restriction preserves K-flatness
statement: Fix prime ell, a finite intermediate field E of PadicAlgCl ell, a maximal-ideal generator pi of its integers, and a Noetherian scheme X. For every integer-indexed K-flat complex P of internal modules over the continuous integral coefficients, termwise restriction along the actual scalarMap ell E X of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients] is K-flat. No boundedness or flat-term assumption is made.

source.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); Stacks Tags 099L, 03ET, 00YV, 06YQ and 09AL.

proof.text: Apply embedded scalar flatness on the coefficient-sized site. Identify categorical flatness with independent-universe flatness. Transfer it to the original pro-etale site using the local equational criterion: lift an object and its finite relation by AsSmall.up, push its covering sieve through AsSmall.down, and use fullness, faithfulness and the induced topology to transfer the solutions.

The section-module comap and regular-module isomorphisms identify this with flatness of the restricted section-ring unit. Section tensor reconstruction identifies native K-flatness with independent-coefficient K-flatness. Apply flat scalar restriction and transport the result back through those isomorphisms.

theorem embeddedIntegralRestrictionKFlat
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (P : CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) :
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat
      (((Mod.comap (scalarMap ℓ E X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
